integrity: Self-review of new claim only; finite exact arithmetic checks do not constitute independent validation of infinite arguments or bibliographic priority.
scientific_limitations: The normalized sharp-order discrepancy need not converge; only explicit liminf/limsup barriers are proved. The argument is confined to integer r>=2 and the half-weight 2^{-omega(n)}. Classical Selberg--Delange asymptotics are used as an input.
title: Sharp one-sided root-log discrepancy for half-weighted minimal-power divisor sums
